platform: Apple M4 Pro, macOS arm64, one thread

method.input: Identical prepared signed TINYINT/SMALLINT/INT values, NULL every seventh row when enabled; stock BinaryRowData versus Rust Arrow buffers.

method.stock_controls: flink belongs to the candidate process; prior-stock is the independent stock control in the previous-encoder process.
method.pipeline: INT source, one million rows, UTC, blackhole; two warmups, five measured trials, alternating engine order; startup, JNI and both transposes retained.
